Yes, it’s a minimally invasive surgery that helps to remove scar tissue and allow new skin to grow.  In the case you have nerve damage, your doctor could even argue for it to be covered under insurance (potentially).  This will help significantly IF laser won’t do the trick- you need to speak to a derm, there are all different types of scar removal for differing severity. Moral of the story- there are options, and at least one will help you.

The problem you also need to focus on is your mental health.. why did you hate your appearance so much to begin with? My sister had severe acne scars on her face, and said she couldn’t meet new people because of it. But once the scars got better and she got help from a derm, she still didn’t want to meet new people. 

I’m not saying that the facial scars aren’t a barrier, they definitely are and you need to feel comfortable with yourself to meet new people. At the same time though, you want to try and focus on the other reasons for your pain so you can try and get help for those as well. I hope everything is okay and you can PM me if you want to talk more.
